panels.rationale: Pre-surgical lateral radiograph of the right foot showing classic manifestations of congenital vertical talus including vertical talar alignment, dorsal talonavicular dislocation, convex plantar rocker-bottom contour, and fixed calcaneal equinus.

in_text_mentions: enital vertical talus challenging on plain radiographs. When analyzing changes in the mutual bone arrangement in the radiological examination of the foot with suspicion of congenital vertical talus from among many evaluated radiological parameters, attention should be paid to the vertical position of the talus, the cuboid on the anterior part of the calcaneus, talocalcaneal angle and angular relationship between the talus axis and the first metatarsal bone axis (TAMBA) [6, 8, 9] (Figs. 6 and 7).Fig. 6Case 1 AP and L X-ray before surgery (after 5 casts)Fig. 7Case 2 AP and L X-ray before surgery
